$comment: Identity is frozen by artifacts/design/rule-catalog-v1.md. Message wording is not governed here — content.error-messages-actionable owns it, per Standard 20. forms.error-field-association governs association only; the split is recorded in the freeze's reconciliation findings.

rules.title: Every control has a programmatically associated label
rules.description: A form control's label is associated with it in markup, not merely positioned near it. Where a control has a known input purpose, that purpose is declared.
rules.rationale: Proximity is a visual relationship only. A control whose label is nearby but unassociated is announced without it, and clicking the label does nothing.
rules.remediation: Associate the label with the control by reference or by containment, and declare input type and autocomplete purpose.
rules.$assuranceNote: The detector covers HTML-like templates. Controls composed in component code are not enumerable from source, so absence of a finding is not proof of association.

rules.title: Required and optional status is visible before submission
rules.description: Which fields must be completed is visible while the form is being filled in, rather than discovered by submitting it. The indication does not rely on color alone.
rules.rationale: Discovering a requirement by failing is the most avoidable kind of form failure, and it costs most where the form is longest.
rules.remediation: Indicate required or optional status at the field, consistently across the form.
rules.$assuranceNote: A required attribute in source says the field is required, not that its status is visible to the user. Only review of the rendered form establishes that.

rules.title: A validation error is associated with the field that failed
rules.description: A validation error identifies which field failed and is programmatically associated with it, so the error is reachable from the control rather than only visible near it.
rules.rationale: An error a user cannot attribute to a field is an instruction to guess. For anyone not seeing the layout, an unassociated message may not be encountered at all.
rules.remediation: Reference the error from the control, and mark the control as invalid while the error stands.
rules.$assuranceNote: Association declared in a template is visible; association wired at runtime is not. Whether the message itself is useful belongs to content.error-messages-actionable.

rules.title: Entered data survives validation failure
rules.description: A failed submission does not clear what the user entered.
rules.rationale: This is the single most damaging common form defect: the cost of one mistake becomes re-entering everything, and it lands hardest on the longest forms.
rules.remediation: Re-render the form with the submitted values and the errors alongside them.
rules.$assuranceNote: Establishing this requires submitting a form, failing validation, and observing what remains. Source shows the intent to preserve, not the result.

rules.title: Submission state is visible and duplicate submission is prevented
rules.description: A form in flight says so, and the same submission cannot be sent twice by pressing again.
rules.rationale: Without a visible in-flight state the reasonable response to silence is to press again, and the interface's ambiguity becomes the user's duplicate order.
rules.remediation: Show a submitting state and disable or guard the submit path until the request resolves.
rules.$assuranceNote: Whether a second submission is actually prevented is established by attempting it. The static rule forms.button-type covers only one common cause.

rules.title: Buttons inside a form declare their type
rules.description: A button inside a form declares whether it submits, resets, or does neither, rather than relying on the implicit default.
rules.rationale: The default is submit. A button intended to do something else silently submits the form instead, which is a class of bug that presents as data loss rather than as a wrong button.
rules.$assuranceNote: The detector sees buttons written inside a form in the same file. A button rendered into a form by a component elsewhere is not visible to it.
